THESEEKER-THE-BEST-DEFENSE.title: The Best Defense
THESEEKER-THE-BEST-DEFENSE.description: Whenever you play an attack, gain 1 block. Scales with dexterity.
THESEEKER-CONJURE_UP.title: Conjure Up
THESEEKER-CONJURE_UP.description: Play a random Attack from your draw pile. Gain {Block} Block.
THESEEKER-ENDOW.title: Endow
THESEEKER-ENDOW.description: Deal {Damage} to an enemy 2 times. Choose an attack in your discard pile, it gains {Block} block.
